read_multiple_files.desc: Read multiple files at once in a single call — more efficient than calling read_file repeatedly. Each file's content is returned with its path as a header. Failed reads are reported inline.

params.paths: Array of file paths to read
params.max_bytes_per_file: Max bytes per file. Default: 10485760 (10 MB).

write_multiple_files.desc: Write content to multiple files in a single call — more efficient than calling write_file repeatedly. Creates or overwrites each file. Creates parent dirs automatically.

params.create_dirs: Create missing parent directories. Default: true
params.show_diff: When true, include a per-file unified diff of what changed for files that were overwritten. Default: false (unlike write_file which defaults to true — disabled here to reduce output when writing many files).

find_replace_in_files.desc: Find and replace text across multiple files. Supports literal strings and Go regex with $1,$2 back-references. Returns per-file diffs (show_diff defaults to true). Transparently handles CRLF (\r\n) files — patterns with LF-only (\n) match correctly, and the original line endings are preserved after editing. In dry_run mode no files are written; the response previews matching files with diffs (or set show_diff=false to get just the file list).

params.path: Root file or directory to search
params.use_regex: Treat old_str as a Go regular expression. Default: false
params.glob: Only process files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go). Default: all files
params.dry_run: Preview matches without writing. Default: false
params.show_diff: Include a unified diff for each changed file. Default: true
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files and directories. Default: false

path_exists_batch.desc: Check whether multiple paths exist in a single call. Returns each path's existence, type (file/directory/symlink), and size. More efficient than calling path_exists repeatedly.

params.paths: Array of file/directory paths to check

get_multiple_file_info.desc: Return metadata for multiple files/directories in a single call. Each entry includes type, size, modification time, permissions, symlink target, and line count for text files. More efficient than calling get_file_info repeatedly.

params.paths: Array of file/directory paths to inspect
